mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicate accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 6.5% (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts (INDPRO and HOUST both below 3-month moving averages) indicate broad economic contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline below 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized above 3.0%) during late-cycle expansions accelerates corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST increasing month-over-month) reflect improving consumer confidence and residential investment, boosting corporate revenues and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL inflation rate > 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% month-over-month) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 0.2% and UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
